listing.name: Xonotic
listing.summary: Play Xonotic's standalone arena shooter with the maps and game data included in its official release.
listing.download_block_reason: Get Xonotic from its official download page or Flathub. Upstream serves the ZIP outside Portcove's package providers.

steps.title: Run the player from the release folder
steps.instruction: Extract the full official ZIP and keep data beside the player in the Xonotic folder. On Windows start xonotic.exe for x64 or xonotic-x86.exe for 32-bit Windows. On Linux x64 run ./xonotic-linux-sdl.sh with glibc 2.29 or newer, SDL2, libvorbisfile, libcurl, libpng and a working OpenGL 2.1 driver. On Intel Mac open Xonotic.app from the Xonotic folder. The dedicated server binaries cannot open the player.

steps.title: Play your extracted Linux x64 copy from Portcove CLI
steps.instruction: Run portcove external select-preview xonotic /path/to/Xonotic/xonotic-linux64-sdl --working-directory /path/to/Xonotic using your actual absolute paths. Use portcove external select with the same inputs, plus --expected-preview with the displayed SHA-256 and --yes. Start the registered copy with portcove exec xonotic. Keep the package and your ~/.xonotic profile outside the Portcove library. Removing the registration leaves both in place.

steps.title: Use the package manager if you installed the Flatpak
steps.instruction: On Linux you can install org.xonotic.Xonotic through Flathub. Use your Flatpak app manager to update or remove that copy. Its profile lives at ~/.var/app/org.xonotic.Xonotic/.xonotic.

steps.title: Keep your settings and custom maps
steps.instruction: Close the game and copy the full profile before replacing your package. For the official ZIP copy Saved Games/xonotic from your Windows user folder, ~/.xonotic on Linux, or ~/Library/Application Support/xonotic on Mac. Keep your private stats key with the backup and copy custom content added to the installation separately.

references.title: Try the X11 player if the match renders black
references.instruction: From the extracted Xonotic folder on Linux x64, run ./xonotic-linux64-glx +gl_texturecompression 0 with a working X11 and GLX session. This uses the same game data and profile as the SDL player.

references.title: Check Apple Silicon and Android availability
references.instruction: The stable ZIP contains an Intel Mac player. Apple Silicon does not have a native player in that ZIP, and Android has no official stable package in this release.
